past_participatory_workshop_study.text: We conducted a workshop with twelve participants and analyzed their interactions. This paper reports three empirical themes and design implications.

future_research_work.text: Our research will explore how participants interact with multiple interface panels in future work.

findings: All 11 actual original research-PDF negatives remain false.
Both earlier interface-panel examples, including one with ordinary research discussion elsewhere, now return false. Explicit planned-conference-panel example remains true.

The updated panel/course guard requires event-specific framing within the same local event context. The exact source-bound R-PAP-39 holds continue covering prospective sessions whose literal phrasing falls outside this conservative general classifier.

paper_source_texts still reads same-work original abstract and cached primary pages from ctx.hits without title inference or cross-work borrowing. Recovery-only rows outside ctx.hits need explicit source reviews.
decision: No overreach found in the actual held research class or the reported interface-panel boundary probes after the same-event guard. Generic rule is conservative and source-bound exact holds remain necessary.
